# Symfony AI Agent Skills

> AI agent skills for the [Symfony AI](https://ai.symfony.com) PHP components: Platform, Agent, Chat, Store, AI Bundle, MCP Bundle, and Mate. Built on the agentskills.io open standard.

## Orchestrator

- [Symfony AI Orchestrator](skills/symfony-ai/SKILL.md): Decision tree that routes between Platform, Agent, Chat, Store, AI Bundle, MCP Bundle, and Mate.

## Skills

### Platform — invoke any LLM

- [Platform](skills/platform/SKILL.md): Unified LLM invocation (chat, structured output, tool calling, embeddings, failover).
- [Platform API Reference](skills/platform/references/api.md)
- [Platform Bridges](skills/platform/references/bridges.md): All 37 supported providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Gemini, VertexAI, Ollama, Mistral, etc.).
- [Platform Embeddings](skills/platform/references/embeddings.md)
- [Platform Patterns](skills/platform/references/patterns.md)
- [Platform Gotchas](skills/platform/references/gotchas.md)

### Agent — tool-calling, memory, multi-agent

- [Agent](skills/agent/SKILL.md): Build autonomous AI agents with input/output processors.
- [Agent API Reference](skills/agent/references/api.md)
- [Agent Patterns](skills/agent/references/patterns.md)
- [Agent Gotchas](skills/agent/references/gotchas.md)

### Chat — stateful conversation

- [Chat](skills/chat/SKILL.md): Send messages to an Agent and persist the conversation.
- [Chat API Reference](skills/chat/references/api.md)
- [Chat Patterns](skills/chat/references/patterns.md)
- [Chat Gotchas](skills/chat/references/gotchas.md)

### Store — vector DB and RAG

- [Store](skills/store/SKILL.md): Store and query documents in a vector database. Requires a Platform for embeddings.
- [Store API Reference](skills/store/references/api.md)
- [Store Bridges](skills/store/references/bridges.md): All 24 supported vector stores.
- [Store Patterns](skills/store/references/patterns.md)
- [Store Gotchas](skills/store/references/gotchas.md)

### AI Bundle — Symfony integration

- [AI Bundle](skills/ai-bundle/SKILL.md): YAML config, attributes (#[AsTool], #[IsGrantedTool]), profiler.
- [AI Bundle Config](skills/ai-bundle/references/config.md)
- [AI Bundle Processors](skills/ai-bundle/references/processors.md)
- [AI Bundle Security](skills/ai-bundle/references/security.md)
- [AI Bundle Patterns](skills/ai-bundle/references/patterns.md)
- [AI Bundle Gotchas](skills/ai-bundle/references/gotchas.md)

### MCP Bundle — MCP server in your app

- [MCP Bundle](skills/mcp-bundle/SKILL.md): Build an MCP server inside a Symfony app (tools, prompts, resources).
- [MCP Bundle API Reference](skills/mcp-bundle/references/api.md)
- [MCP Bundle Patterns](skills/mcp-bundle/references/patterns.md)
- [MCP Bundle Gotchas](skills/mcp-bundle/references/gotchas.md)

### Mate — dev tool for AI assistants to introspect your app

- [Mate](skills/mate/SKILL.md): Standalone MCP dev server so the AI assistant can read your Symfony app's logs, profiler, container. Dev only.
- [Mate API Reference](skills/mate/references/api.md)
- [Mate Patterns](skills/mate/references/patterns.md)
- [Mate Gotchas](skills/mate/references/gotchas.md)
